texts.value: Enhances the ATPase activity of DHX15 by acting like a brace that tethers mobile sections of DHX15 together, stabilizing a functional conformation with high RNA affinity of DHX15 (PubMed:12381793). Involved in the constitutive silencing of the interferon beta promoter, independently of the virus-induced signals, and in the inhibition of the basal and cytokine-induced iNOS promoter activity (PubMed:12381793). Also involved in the regulation of IL-8 transcription (PubMed:12381793). May also act as a DNA-binding transcription regulator: interacts with a specific negative regulatory element (NRE) 5'-AATTCCTCTGA-3' to mediate transcriptional repression of certain NK-kappa-B responsive genes (PubMed:10562553)
Interacts with NF-kappa-B (PubMed:10562553). Interacts with XRN2 (PubMed:24462208). Interacts (via G-patch domain) with DHX15; promoting the RNA helicase activity of DHX15 (PubMed:32179686)
Widely and constitutively expressed (PubMed:10562553). Expressed at lower level in colon, peripheral blood lymphocytes, lung and kidney (PubMed:10562553)
